title: Russian Strikes Kill 5 Across Ukraine; Odesa Historic Centre Hit, Rivne Grid Cut
detail: Over the 24 hours to Nov 18 Russian attacks killed at least five people and injured 15. In Odesa, at least four died and 13 were wounded in air strikes that Zelensky called brutal and deliberate, with first responders also targeted; three strikes hit the historic centre, one in a UNESCO-protected area. Ukraine's Air Force said Russia launched 141 long-range drones overnight, 73 of them jet-powered, and 126 were intercepted. Energy facilities were damaged in Kyiv, Mykolaiv and Rivne oblasts; an outage in Rivne cut power to more than 80 settlements. Donetsk oblast reported four deaths and Kharkiv oblast one. Note: casualty counts by oblast come from regional authorities and overlap between sources.
